purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for non-older people who need support at home because of disability-related functional needs. Scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility, legal basis, local process or healthcare responsibility. Socialstyrelsen and 1177 are used for current truth-bearing boundaries; municipal details remain local verification tasks.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage; these scores are not measured search volumes.

natural_language_queries: jag är 34 och har en funktionsnedsättning kan jag få hemtjänst
jag behöver boendestöd för att få struktur hemma vart vänder jag mig
kan jag få trygghetslarm om jag inte är äldre
jag har funktionsnedsättning och behöver hjälp hemma vem ska jag ringa
vad är skillnaden mellan boendestöd hemtjänst och hemsjukvård
min mamma är under 65 och funktionsnedsatt och behöver stöd hemma

demand_signal.basis: Socialstyrelsen reports that on 31 October 2025, 63,300 people with disabilities had at least one ongoing SoL intervention; boendestod was most common, followed by home help in ordinary housing and safety alarms. This is an official service-use signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: Natural phrases such as help at home can mean boendestod, home help, a safety alarm, personal assistance or healthcare at home. v54 correctly stopped ambiguous home-support words from being labeled eldercare, but that safety fix exposed a dead-end risk for younger disability contexts.

miss_consequence.basis: Mislabeling a younger person as eldercare can erode trust and route to the wrong service family; suppressing the route without a replacement can leave a high-impact support need without a concrete next action.

source_fragmentation.basis: National disability/social-service boundaries are described by Socialstyrelsen while exact boendestod, home-help and safety-alarm processes are municipal, and healthcare at home follows healthcare routes that require current 1177/local verification.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as boendestod, hemtjanst, trygghetslarm, LSS, SoL and hemsjukvard are difficult to distinguish, especially for users with cognitive accessibility needs, low digital familiarity, or Arabic/Persian language needs.

steps_to_action.basis: A useful route can first separate structure/routine support, practical/personal home support, safety and healthcare at home, then point to current municipal and healthcare information without collecting diagnosis, identity or exact address.

recurrence_signal.basis: Socialstyrelsen's 2025 national statistics show recurring use of boendestod, home help and safety alarms among people with disabilities, and the share of people aged 0-64 receiving boendestod has increased annually since 2014.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The product has personal-assistance, housing-adaptation and age-30 disability routes, but after v54 it intentionally rejects younger disability plus generic home-help/safety-alarm stories from the eldercare route without yet giving those users a focused replacement route.

signals.product_miss: The v54 eldercare false-positive repair was correct but incomplete: it prevented younger disability stories from entering an older-person route without creating the corresponding same-product disability home-support next step.
signals.future_guardrail: Keep one shared person product. Require disability/functional context for ambiguous home-help or safety-alarm language, except explicit boendestod discovery; fail closed on older-person context and generic post-operation healthcare. Ask at most one broad need-type question and never infer diagnosis, entitlement, hours, fees, legal basis or local responsibility.
signals.evaluation_method: Run the four v55 cases plus existing v53/v54 eldercare regressions; require sv/ar/fa route detection, no parent-word age inference, one high-information need split, privacy-safe handoff, structured feedback, current primary-source links and separate social-support versus healthcare paths.
signals.recommended_learning_action: Add disability_home_support to the existing public shell/person pilot and revise the older-home detector so parent relationship alone is not treated as proof of older age. Preserve the v54 negative boundaries and add permanent cross-actor regression coverage.
signals.truth_rule: VERIFY the concrete municipal service, process, fee and current healthcare contact before giving a specific local action. Do not infer eligibility, diagnosis requirement, legal basis, hours, fees, or whether municipality/region is the healthcare actor from the user's story.
